## Goal
`run_checks` (`src/freemyid/doctor.py:354-368`) never tells the person when letters will not cite their state's law because the matrix is missing or broken (`law_matrix.load` returns `EMPTY`, `src/freemyid/engine/law_matrix.py:111-126`), or when the data folder's disk is nearly full (evidence and logs keep growing).

## Order
BLOCKED: needs an in-house contract change first. Adding checks changes the `doctor/1` check list documented in `docs/CLI.md:321` (Grok's lane) and asserted in `tests/test_cli_doctor.py:37,198` and `tests/codex/test_cx_cli_doctor_text.py:23,89,118`. In-house will post GO with the new check ids once the contract is agreed. Also after WO-246.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Two new checks, each read-only and never raising (wrap with `_guard`, 44-52): `law_matrix` (ok with version and state count; warn when `EMPTY`, with a plain fix line) and `disk` (warn below 500 MB free in the data folder via `shutil.disk_usage`, fail below 50 MB).
2. Works the same on Windows and Linux (tests monkeypatch `shutil.disk_usage` and the matrix loader; no real disk or file assumptions).
3. Exact ids, titles and order follow the in-house contract decision quoted in the GO message.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
